title: Sebastian and the Debt Again
author: Juniper Fairweather
blurb: Xanthe Vasquez, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
